title: Expose prepare-edit registry and native scoped contract parity
summary: Implement the accepted Top 10 Studio-side convergence queue: broaden the supported-app registry, expose prepare-edit review artifact metadata, and show scoped contract truth in the native supported-app catalog while keeping writes locked.
acceptance_criteria: The localhost supported-app catalog includes more Humble apps beyond HumbleControl and HumbleSudoku.
Prepare-edit export descriptors include session, review artifact, diff, recovery, and locked apply metadata for Control consumers.
Scoped prepare-edit contracts expose the same metadata for a selected app and continue to reject unknown ids.
The native supported-app catalog shows scoped prepare-edit path, session id, review artifact path, and locked apply state.
New native text uses StudioStrings and Localizable.xcstrings; no legacy .strings or L10n namespace is introduced.
Docs record the broader registry and review artifact boundary.
Helper tests, fallback checks, ticket validation, workflow checks, and native build pass or blocked commands are documented honestly.

evidence.note: Expanded the localhost supported-app registry to ten additional Humble-family apps while preserving app-scoped prepare-edit contracts.
Export descriptors and scoped prepare-edit payloads now include Control session, prepare-edit, recovery, review artifact, manifest diff, and locked apply-gate metadata.
Native supported-app catalog now displays scoped prepare-edit path, session id, review artifact path, and locked apply state with StudioStrings and String Catalog localization.
Helper coverage passed for default catalog breadth, manifest metadata, scoped metadata, and unknown-id rejection: 14 tests.

evidence.path: python3 Scripts/check_web_fallback.py && python3 -m py_compile Scripts/*.py && python3 -m json.tool AppleApps/Shared/Resources/Localizable.xcstrings
evidence.note: Web fallback, Python compilation, and string-catalog JSON parsing passed.
Native macOS build and native-ci passed; generated Xcode project ID churn was discarded from the slice.
Strict repo doctor reported expected branch-freshness and dirty-worktree issues for the active topic lane before commit; no production or repository write path was enabled.

trigger.source_ref: Jan accepted all ten next slices for HumbleControl/HumbleStudio convergence.

agent_notes: The native and helper surfaces must describe prepare-edit/review artifacts only; they must not introduce repository mutation.
